_comment: Paths (chosen at level 5) and specializations (chosen at level 10). 'proposed' specializations are Claude's suggestions Reason has not confirmed. talent_rows is empty where the doc only has a capstone so far. suggested_weights drive the auto-assign button and come from the doc's example level 20 builds (points above 10).

paths.name: Wizard
paths.description: Spellbooks, the widest and most complex spells, slow to cast.

capstone.name: Recall
capstone.description: Cast any spell in your book, prepared or not, once per fight

capstone.name: Runic Mastery
capstone.description: Runes trigger instantly and rearm once

capstone.name: Legion
capstone.description: Keep up to three summons at once

paths.name: Mage
paths.description: Verb and noun spells discovered by experiment; power from understanding the universe.

capstone.name: Paradox
capstone.description: Every 20 seconds, your next spell is instant and free

options.name: Echo
options.description: 20% chance a spell repeats at half power

options.name: Borrowed Seconds
options.description: Blink returns you to where you stood 3 seconds ago, restoring health lost since

options.name: Wide Slow
options.description: Slow pairs hit an area instead of one target

options.name: Rewind
options.description: Once per 90 seconds, a killing blow rewinds you 4 seconds instead

options.name: Stolen Time
options.description: Killing a slowed enemy refunds 10% mana

options.name: Patience
options.description: Spells cast after standing still 1 second cost 30% less

options.name: Freeze Frame
options.description: New spell that stops all enemies in an area for 2 seconds

options.name: Age
options.description: Slowed enemies lose 30% armor over 6 seconds

options.name: Loop
options.description: Damage over time ticks twice as fast

options.name: Foresight
options.description: See enemy attacks 0.5 seconds early as ground markers

options.name: Tempo
options.description: Each different spell cast in a row gives +5% cast speed, stacking to 5

options.name: Paradox
options.description: Every 20 seconds, your next spell is instant and free

options.name: Chronarch
options.description: Your Slow also hastes you by the same amount

options.name: Second Self
options.description: Summon your past self, which repeats your last 4 casts

capstone.name: Confluence
capstone.description: Element pairs react (water then freeze shatters, air then burn explodes) for double damage

capstone.name: Superposition
capstone.description: Your spells hit from two places at once

paths.name: Sorcerer
paths.description: Innate arcane power; control unlocks spells with level. Simple, fast, very frequent.

capstone.name: Living Storm
capstone.description: While overstrained, lightning strikes nearby enemies on its own

capstone.name: Gravity Well
capstone.description: Hurled objects pull enemies in as they fly

capstone.name: Embrace the Wild
capstone.description: Overstrain no longer hurts you, but every spell rolls a random surge
